summary: Nivika Fastigheter AB (publ), a property company, owns, manages, and develops residential and commercial premises and rentals in Sweden. Its property portfolio consists of apartment building, student housing, industrial, warehouse, office, school/preschool, and community service properties, as well as plots. Nivika Fastigheter AB (publ) was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Värnamo, Sweden.
